artist.name: SHERAL
artist.bio: Sheral is a Delhi-based DJ and graphic designer who moves through house, bass, breaks, footwork, and techno to shape a sound that is distinctly hers. She is a rising female DJ in the Indian electronic scene, known for her colourful energy and explorative approach. She made her Boiler Room debut in Gurugram (Delhi NCR) in June 2024 alongside Kohra, Prismer, Girls Night Out, and AK Sports. In April 2026, she returned to Boiler Room for a Mumbai double-header, recorded on April 10, 2026, a night that promised relentless energy across the lineup. Active in the Magnetic Fields and DGTL circuit. Also a graphic designer by profession, bringing visual sensibility to her artistic identity.

eras.sound: Glitchy UK bass, breaks, footwork and ghetto tech
